description: The Daihatsu Move Conte  is a kei car built by the Japanese automaker Daihatsu from 2008 to 2016, sold until March 2017. It was a more angular cosmetic variation of the L175 series Move, which had moved away from the boxy look for its fourth generation. The name "Conte" is derived from "container", referring its boxy shape. The Move Conte was also available in the somewhat sportier looking Custom model, with headlights incorporating an overlapping, round element.
